name: Grade 9 IIT Summative: Python and Data
description: Ten core second-trimester words for the Grade 9 Python and data vocabulary table.

words.definition: A programming language used for coding.
words.example: The student wrote a Python program to store and print class data.

words.definition: A group of related items stored together.
words.example: The list stored the names of the project materials.
Each item in the list represented one survey answer.

words.definition: A position number in a list.
words.example: The student used index 0 to get the first item in the list.
The student's name was stored as a string in the program.
The loop printed each value from the data list.

words.definition: A rule that can be true or false.
words.example: The condition checked whether the score was greater than 70.

words.definition: Facts or values that can be used or studied.
words.example: The program used survey data to count how many students chose each option.

words.definition: Information stored in a variable, cell, or program.
words.example: The variable stored the value entered by the user.

words.definition: What a system or program produces.
words.example: The output showed the final count on the screen.
